name: Doorbell
description: Live picture from a Dahua video doorbell (VTO). When someone rings: a chime from the Deck's speaker, the light strip blinks and this screen comes up — no computer needed
config_help: Needs the doorbell service on the Deck (see the README). Add this widget to a scene and switch that scene off: it then only appears when someone rings.

url.name: Picture URL
url.description: Where the doorbell picture comes from; the default is the doorbell service on this Deck

ring_url.name: Status URL
ring_url.description: The doorbell service's status; the default is the one on this Deck
